title: Hiring Process Overview
content: The hiring process for student assistantship positions at Hamilton University involves several key steps: 1) Collecting applications, 2) Initial screening by the HR department, 3) Interviews conducted by the Academic Selection Panel, 4) Deliberation and decision-making by the hiring committee, and 5) Offer letters sent out to selected candidates.

title: Assistantship Position Workflow
content: Workflow for assistantship positions: - Application deadline set for March 1st. - HR screens applications by March 15th. - Interviews scheduled from March 20th to April 5th. - Hiring committee meets to make decisions by April 10th. - Successful candidates notified by April 15th. - Onboarding begins on May 1st.
